## Analysis

The exhaustive two-phase width-4 search failed, so neither a single interior phase transition nor eight-row endpoint polishing escapes the incumbent basin. Together with the four-row block census, this establishes broader local optimality for width-4 constructions, not merely fringe optimality. However, other moduli were explored mainly by annealing, genetic search, or restricted mask families; no run systematically enumerated all periodic residue masks. The remaining plausible structural gap is therefore a different core modulus whose best mask occupies a narrow basin missed by stochastic searches.
